en-US.title: Architecture
en-US.intro: Woody generates this file from the code index and the source code. After every index it rewrites the part between the woody:generated markers. Everything else, including the Change rules section, belongs to you and is kept.
en-US.basis: Generated {date} from an index in {mode} mode.
en-US.tasksNone: No task creation (xTaskCreate, xTaskCreateStatic, osThreadNew) was found.
en-US.tablesIntro: Arrays of functions that a loop calls one by one, in this order.
en-US.otherTables: Other function tables, not reached from a task
en-US.structTablesIntro: Arrays and structs whose fields hold functions. Code calls these functions through a pointer, such as `p->field(...)`, so the index shows no callers for them. Each line gives the table, the functions in each field, and where that field is called.
en-US.orderIntro: Keep these when you add, move or remove an entry.
en-US.matrix: Modules and the tables they register in
en-US.unreadable: {count} source files could not be read as text: {files}.
en-US.demoSkipped: {count} task creations in demo or example folders were left out.
en-US.entryUnknown: {site}: the task entry {expression} is not a function name.
en-US.tableUnknown: {site}: calls through {table}, but its definition was not found.
en-US.tableParameter: {site}: calls through {table}, which is not an array defined in the code (a parameter or a pointer).
en-US.rulesPlaceholder: Write your team's rules for changing this project here: where parameters are stored, naming, how a new module registers, and which modules follow their own style. Woody keeps this section when it updates the file.
en-US.entriesNotIndexed: These table entries name functions that are not in the index: {names}. Their folder may be skipped by the indexer (the Architecture panel lists skipped source folders), or they may be excluded by #if.
en-US.entryNotIndexed: {site}: the task entry {expression} is not in the index; its folder may be skipped, or it may be excluded by #if.
en-US.entryParameter: {site}: {creator} creates a task from its parameter {expression}; the tasks it creates depend on who calls {creator}.
en-US.modulesIntro: Modules found from the dispatch tables, standalone tasks and struct function tables: each source file (or split <module>_*.c group in one folder) that registers entries there, with its headers and the source files whose functions share its name prefix. Choose in the Architecture panel which modules get an expert; one expert can take several modules.
en-US.modulesNone: No source file registers functions in a dispatch table.
en-US.cardIntro: Woody rewrites the part between the woody:generated markers from the code index and the source after every index; do not edit it. The expert writes the feature card after it and keeps the section with the user's corrections unchanged.
en-US.briefBasis: Generated on {date} from the index ({mode} mode) and the source of the files this expert owns.
en-US.briefNoFiles: No indexed file matches this expert's paths.
en-US.fileUnusable: parse failed across the file, read it directly
en-US.fileChanged: changed after the last index, positions may be off
en-US.entryNoFile: The path {entry} matches no indexed file.
en-US.entriesNone: Woody found no function of this module in a task, dispatch table or struct table. Look at the callers below and search for the tables or macros that reach it.
en-US.providesNone: The index shows no call into this module from other files.
en-US.moreProvides: … {count} more functions called from outside, callers not shown: {names}. Look up their callers before you trace a path through them.
en-US.providesGap: Calls through macros, function pointers and tables between firmware images are often missing here; check with search_code before concluding that a function has no callers.
en-US.globalsIntro: Read from the source, because the index misses many globals. Uses in other files were found by text search.
en-US.globalStatics: File-local (static): {names}. A * marks one missing from the index graph.
en-US.checkIntro: Verify these in the source before relying on the index for this module:
en-US.checkNone: No problem recorded for this module's files.
en-US.checkUnusable: {file}: the index could not parse this file; read it directly.
en-US.checkPartial: {file}: lines {ranges} were only partly parsed; code there may be missing from the index.
en-US.checkChanged: {file}: changed after the last index; line numbers and calls in the index may be off. Read the file directly.
en-US.checkMissingFunctions: Defined in the source but missing from the index: {names}.
en-US.checkMissingGlobals: {count} globals are not in the index graph; use search_code for them: {names}.
en-US.vectorApisIntro: Pointer macros and entry structs that forward calls across firmware images (such as Boot, APP1 and APP2).
en-US.dataTablesIntro: Large source tables and X-Macro headers scanned directly from the source, including files the parser could not index.
en-US.modulesShared: Candidate shared files (referenced across modules, not yet owned): {files}.
en-US.driftFiles: Unowned files detected in the same module (possible split or refactor; consider updating experts.json): {files}.
en-US.unindexedFiles: Files on disk matching this expert's paths but not in the index (skipped or added since last index; read them directly): {files}.
en-US.briefExternalGlobals: External globals read or written (data sources & side effects)
en-US.externalGlobalsIntro: Non-static globals defined in other files that this module writes, takes the address of, or reads (found by source scan).
en-US.briefTypes: Module data types, enums and X-Macro tables
en-US.addressDefinedOnly: defined here, not referenced directly inside owned files

zh-CN.title: 架构
zh-CN.intro: 本文件由 Woody 根据代码索引和源码生成。每次索引后，woody:generated 标记之间的内容会被重写；其余部分（包括“改动规范”一节）归你们维护，会原样保留。
zh-CN.tablesIntro: 由循环按顺序逐个调用的函数数组，顺序即执行顺序。
zh-CN.definedUnder: 这份定义只在 {condition} 时生效。
zh-CN.otherTables: 其他函数表（不从任务进入）
zh-CN.otherTableLine: 由 {dispatcher} 调用，共 {count} 个函数
zh-CN.structTablesIntro: 字段里存放函数的数组和结构体。代码通过指针调用这些函数（例如 `p->field(...)`），所以索引里看不到它们的调用者。每行列出表、每个字段里的函数，以及该字段在哪里被调用。
zh-CN.orderIntro: 增加、移动或删除表项时必须遵守。
zh-CN.matrix: 模块在各调度表中的登记
zh-CN.unreadable: 有 {count} 个源文件无法按文本读取：{files}。
zh-CN.demoSkipped: demo 或 example 目录里有 {count} 处创建任务的代码，未计入。
zh-CN.tableUnknown: {site}：通过 {table} 调用，但没有找到它的定义。
zh-CN.tableParameter: {site}：通过 {table} 调用，它不是代码里定义的数组（可能是参数或指针）。
zh-CN.unreferenced: {site}：在 {creator} 中创建 {task}，但没有任何地方调用 {creator}。
zh-CN.rulesPlaceholder: 在这里写下你们团队修改本工程的规则：参数存放在哪里、命名方式、新模块如何登记、哪些模块沿用自己的写法。Woody 更新本文件时会保留这一节。
zh-CN.entriesNotIndexed: 这些表项的函数不在索引中：{names}。可能是所在目录被索引程序跳过了（架构面板会列出被跳过的源码目录），也可能被 #if 排除了。
zh-CN.entryNotIndexed: {site}：任务入口 {expression} 不在索引中，可能是所在目录被跳过，或被 #if 排除。
zh-CN.entryParameter: {site}：{creator} 用参数 {expression} 创建任务，具体是哪个任务取决于谁调用 {creator}。
zh-CN.modulesIntro: 按调度表、独立任务和结构体函数表识别出的模块：每个在其中登记了入口的源文件（或同一目录下拆分成 <模块>_*.c 的一组文件）算一个模块，连同对应头文件，以及函数名前缀与它相同的其他源文件。在架构面板里选择哪些模块设专家；一位专家可以负责几个模块。
zh-CN.modulesNone: 没有源文件在调度表里登记函数。
zh-CN.cardIntro: woody:generated 标记之间的内容由 Woody 在每次索引后根据代码索引和源码重写，不要手动修改。专家在它后面写功能卡片，“用户更正”一节保持不变。
zh-CN.briefBasis: 生成于 {date}，依据索引（{mode} 模式）和本专家负责文件的源码。
zh-CN.briefNoFiles: 没有已索引的文件与本专家的路径匹配。
zh-CN.fileUnusable: 整个文件解析失败，请直接读源码
zh-CN.filePartial: 第 {ranges} 行只解析了一部分
zh-CN.fileChanged: 索引后改过，位置可能偏移
zh-CN.entryNoFile: 路径 {entry} 没有匹配到任何已索引的文件。
zh-CN.entryRunByTask: 由任务 {task} 中的 {dispatcher} 执行
zh-CN.entriesNone: Woody 没有在任务、调度表或结构体函数表里找到本模块的函数。请看下面的调用方，并搜索调用它的表或宏。
zh-CN.providesNone: 索引里没有其他文件调用本模块。
zh-CN.moreProvides: ……另有 {count} 个函数被模块外调用，这里未列调用方：{names}。追踪经过它们的路径前，先查出它们的调用方。
zh-CN.providesGap: 经宏、函数指针或固件镜像之间接口表的调用经常不在这里；断定某个函数没有调用方之前，先用 search_code 核对。
zh-CN.globalsIntro: 从源码读取，因为索引漏收了很多全局变量。其他文件里的使用位置由全文搜索得到。
zh-CN.globalStatics: 文件内（static）：{names}。带 * 的不在索引图中。
zh-CN.checkIntro: 依赖索引回答本模块的问题之前，先在源码里核对这些：
zh-CN.checkNone: 本模块的文件没有记录到问题。
zh-CN.checkUnusable: {file}：索引无法解析这个文件，请直接读源码。
zh-CN.checkPartial: {file}：第 {ranges} 行只解析了一部分，那里的代码可能不在索引中。
zh-CN.checkChanged: {file}：索引后改过，索引里的行号和调用可能已经偏移，请直接读源码。
zh-CN.checkMissingFunctions: 源码里有定义、索引里没有的函数：{names}。
zh-CN.checkMissingGlobals: {count} 个全局变量不在索引图中，请用 search_code 查：{names}。
zh-CN.vectorApisIntro: 跨固件镜像（如 Boot、APP1、APP2）转发调用的指针宏与入口结构体表。
zh-CN.dataTablesIntro: 直接从源码扫描出的大型数据表与 X-Macro 头文件（含解析器未能建索引的文件）。
zh-CN.modulesShared: 建议归入共享（shared）的公共文件（跨模块共用、当前无归属）：{files}。
zh-CN.driftFiles: 同一模块下发现未归属文件（可能是模块拆分或重构新增，建议更新 experts.json）：{files}。
zh-CN.unindexedFiles: 磁盘上符合本专家路径但不在索引中的文件（可能被跳过或索引后新增，请直接读源码）：{files}。
zh-CN.timerLine: RTOS 定时器回调 {name}，创建于 {site}
zh-CN.moreUses: ……另有 {count} 个被调用的模块/分组未展开：{groups}。
zh-CN.briefExternalGlobals: 读写的外部全局变量（数据来源与外部状态变更）
zh-CN.externalGlobalsIntro: 本模块写入、取地址或读取的其他文件全局变量（由源码扫描得到）。
zh-CN.moreGlobals: ……另有 {count} 个被外部使用的全局变量：{names}。
zh-CN.moreExternalGlobals: ……另有 {count} 个引用的外部全局变量：{names}。
zh-CN.briefTypes: 模块数据结构、枚举与 X-Macro 表
zh-CN.moreAddresses: ……另有 {count} 个存储/地址宏或标识：{names}。
zh-CN.addressDefinedOnly: 在本模块定义，模块内未直接引用
